entry.goal: Select the requested medium and editing scope from the existing brief; ask only for missing material context.

web.goal: Preserve content/DOM order; advise on lang, direction, wrapping, fallback and actionable UI.

documents.goal: Preserve logical source; review hierarchy for paper, document, slide or display viewing conditions.

review.goal: Read-only findings with evidence, rule IDs and scoped recommendations; no writeback.

font_size: No hard-coded global size; choose actual font/medium/reader/distance and measure.
